description: 5 entries over 14 days — tests economy and selection

entries.text: Woke up early before everyone else. Made coffee and sat by the window for a while. The street was quiet. Keep thinking about the new project — whether the core abstraction is right or whether we are building something too clever for its own good.
Had dinner with Jordan tonight. Cooked from scratch — turned out better than last time. We talked about work and what the next year might look like for both of us. Felt warm and grounded after.

Long meeting with the team. Demoed the new feature. People seemed genuinely impressed but I am not sure they understand what it took to get here. The key insight was the one that clicked last month — once that landed everything else followed.
Photo taken at the hiking trail near the reservoir. Clear morning, light through the trees. Went alone — needed the silence.

Finished a book about the history of a great research lab tonight. Feels like a different world — a time when institutions had the patience to let ideas breathe. I wonder if anything like that is possible now.
